title: Family, Golf, Friends 6BR/4BA, heated pool/spa.
description:
Welcome to Los Altos House, your private resort-style retreat in Chandler, perfectly located just minutes from Chandler Fashion Center, golf courses, restaurants, and freeways 101 & 202 for easy access throughout the Phoenix metro area.

Designed for families, golf trips, sports teams, reunions, and groups of friends, this spacious home offers the perfect combination of comfort, entertainment, and convenience so everyone can stay together under one roof.

 The space 
Huge master bedroom with king bed uptairs with ensuite bathroom, walk in closet and 60" smart TV, bedroom 2 (2 bunk beds, 4 twin total) and bedroom 3 (queen bed and twin/twin bunkbed) share a jack n jill bathroom, bedroom 4 (king bed) and bedroom 5 (king bed and twin/twin bunkbed) share another bathroom, bedroom 6 is on main floor (twin/full bunkbed), also full bathroom on main floor.

Dining table for 8, breakfast table for 8 and 3 stools at kitchen countertop for total seating for 19.
THE SPACE:

The fully equipped kitchen features granite countertops and everything needed to prepare meals for large groups, including:

14-cup coffee maker
Keurig single-serve coffee maker
Breville toaster oven
Crockpot
Wine fridge in pantry
Ample cookware, dishes, and serving essentials

Gather together with seating for up to 19 guests:

Dining table for 8
Breakfast table for 8
Kitchen island seating for 3

The main living room is designed for relaxing and entertaining, featuring an oversized 86” Smart TV and an 8-foot pool table just steps away.

Additional entertainment spaces include:

Game room with 65” Smart TV, Xbox, and game table
Upstairs loft with 55” Smart TV
Private office with PC, printer, and 55” Smart TV monitor

All TVs include access to Hulu, Disney+, ESPN+, Netflix, and Max.

BACKYARD PARADISE:

Step outside into your own private Arizona oasis featuring:

Fenced heated pool & spa
Huge 30’ x 30’ grassy area perfect for games and kids
Outdoor living room
Outdoor dining table for 10
Gas grill with prep station
Hammock for relaxing under the Arizona sky

Pool and spa heating are available for an additional $60/day.

FAMILY-FRIENDLY AMENITIES:

Traveling with little ones is easy with:

Graco Pack ’n Play with upgraded mattress
High chair
Stroller
Booster car seat

ADDITIONAL FEATURES:
Ultra-fast WiFi up to 1 Gbps
Self check-in
Smart TVs throughout the home
Washer & dryer
Spacious layout ideal for large groups

Whether you’re visiting for golf, spring training, family vacations, tournaments, or simply to enjoy the Arizona sunshine, Los Altos House offers the perfect home base for your stay in Chandler.
